decision_rule.summary: Compute DWI from wind, dryness, road exposure, facility exposure, and population; the threshold passes only if every numeric gate is true. Point-weather and receptor-context metrics are separate evidence roles.

evaluation_mode_justification: All required fields are fixed calculations from event-window data and threshold gates.

reasoning_depth.counterfactual_rejection: A wetness-led interpretation fails because point precipitation is zero and regional mean precipitation is far below the dryness gate.
reasoning_depth.evidence_weighting: Wind and regional dryness provide the physical dust-transport evidence; road, amenity, and population values are receptor context rather than dust-generation evidence.
reasoning_depth.uncertainty_or_scale_caveat: Receptor counts help prioritize disruption context but do not prove observed dust concentration or health impacts.

evidence_roles.receptor_context: road, amenity, and population components only

criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON fields with numeric values and the final threshold string.
criteria.name: Output schema
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for mostly complete JSON with missing nesting or one missing field.

criteria.description: Uses 11.64 m/s wind, 0.0 mm point precipitation, 0.0152 mm regional mean precipitation, 2.165 mm regional maximum precipitation, 170 major roads, 53 critical amenities, and 6086.444 people while keeping point-weather and receptor-context roles separate.
criteria.name: Core numeric extraction
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for correct values with minor rounding or one omitted receptor metric.

criteria.description: Applies the five clipped component formulas and reports wind 0.91, dryness 0.848, transport 1.0, facility 1.0, and population 0.609.
criteria.name: Component formulas
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for correct formulas with one arithmetic or rounding error.

criteria.description: Computes dust_wind_index as 90.32 within 0.05 using the stated weights.
criteria.name: Weighted index
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the right weighting pattern but an index outside tolerance.

criteria.description: Checks all five gates and gives dust_transport_consistent only because every gate passes.
criteria.name: Threshold gates
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the right final label with incomplete gate accounting.

criteria.description: Keeps the mechanism label to the short computed consequence of the threshold test.
criteria.name: Computed consequence
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points if the label is correct but surrounded by unnecessary narration.

criteria.description: Does not add measured road closures, health thresholds, direct losses, or wet-event dominance beyond the computed gates. Full credit also requires the `reasoning_depth` object to identify decisive evidence, reject the main tempting simplification, and state a bounded uncertainty or scale caveat.
criteria.name: Scope control
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points if one extra inference is hinted but not central.
